description: "History of the United Netherlands, 1588" by John Lothrop Motley is a historical account written during the late 19th century. The book delves into the tumultuous events surrounding the Dutch Republic during the late 16th century, particularly the significant struggles against Spanish rule and the related diplomatic maneuvers involving England.
